    rThermoclineValve_pct := 0.0;          (* Isolate thermal storage fluid matrix *)
    rCondenserDuty_pct := 100.0;           (* 100% cooling water quench to arrest desorber vapors *)
    wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Safety Loop Open *)
    iState := 99;                          (* Trap in CRITICAL_TRIP_SAFE_PARK *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Manual Fault Reset & Alarm Acknowledgment Engine *)
IF bAckFault THEN
    wAlarmWord1 := 16#0000;
    wAlarmWord2 := 16#0000;
    wAlarmWord3 := 16#0000;
    bAlarmTrip := FALSE;
    IF iState = 99 THEN
        iState := 0;                       (* Return to BOOT_INITIALIZE after safety clearance *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2. 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & DISCREPANCY ISOLATION                    *)
(* Median selection, inter-channel deviation tracking, persistent drift accumulation, & degradation  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- Sub-System A: Vacuum Pressure 2oo3 (PT_01A, PT_01B, PT_01C) [mbar] --- *)
bVacDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rVacuumPress_A_mbar - rVacuumPress_B_mbar) > rVacDiscrepancyTol_mbar;
bVacDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rVacuumPress_B_mbar - rVacuumPress_C_mbar) > rVacDiscrepancyTol_mbar;
bVacDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rVacuumPress_C_mbar - rVacuumPress_A_mbar) > rVacDiscrepancyTol_mbar;

IF (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_AB) AND (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_BC) AND (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    (* Healthy Triplet: compute arithmetic mean / median *)
    rVoted_VacPress_mbar := (rVacuumPress_A_mbar + rVacuumPress_B_mbar + rVacuumPress_C_mbar) / 3.0;
    iVacHealthySensorCount := 3;
    bVacSensorFail_A := FALSE;
    bVacSensorFail_B := FALSE;
    bVacSensorFail_C := FALSE;
ELSIF (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_AB) AND (bVacDiscrepancy_BC AND bVacDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    (* Channel C Diverged: degrade to 1oo2 on A and B *)
    rVoted_VacPress_mbar := (rVacuumPress_A_mbar + rVacuumPress_B_mbar) * 0.5;
    iVacHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bVacSensorFail_C := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: PT_01C Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSIF (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_BC) AND (bVacDiscrepancy_AB AND bVacDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    (* Channel A Diverged: degrade to 1oo2 on B and C *)
    rVoted_VacPress_mbar := (rVacuumPress_B_mbar + rVacuumPress_C_mbar) * 0.5;
    iVacHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bVacSensorFail_A := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: PT_01A Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSIF (NOT bVacDiscrepancy_CA) AND (bVacDiscrepancy_AB AND bVacDiscrepancy_BC) THEN
    (* Channel B Diverged: degrade to 1oo2 on C and A *)
    rVoted_VacPress_mbar := (rVacuumPress_C_mbar + rVacuumPress_A_mbar) * 0.5;
    iVacHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bVacSensorFail_B := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: PT_01B Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSE
    (* Complete 2oo3 Voting Collapse: All three channels disagree beyond tolerance *)
    iVacHealthySensorCount := 0;
    wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: 2oo3 Vacuum Instrumentation Trip *)
    rVoted_VacPress_mbar := 1013.25;        (* Default to atmospheric failsafe *)
    bAlarmTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- Sub-System B: Desorption Bed Temperature 2oo3 (TT_01A, TT_01B, TT_01C) [deg C] --- *)
bBedDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rBedTemp_A_degC - rBedTemp_B_degC) > rBedDiscrepancyTol_degC;
bBedDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rBedTemp_B_degC - rBedTemp_C_degC) > rBedDiscrepancyTol_degC;
bBedDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rBedTemp_C_degC - rBedTemp_A_degC) > rBedDiscrepancyTol_degC;

IF (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_AB) AND (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_BC) AND (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_BedTemp_degC := (rBedTemp_A_degC + rBedTemp_B_degC + rBedTemp_C_degC) / 3.0;
    iBedHealthySensorCount := 3;
    bBedSensorFail_A := FALSE;
    bBedSensorFail_B := FALSE;
    bBedSensorFail_C := FALSE;
ELSIF (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_AB) AND (bBedDiscrepancy_BC AND bBedDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_BedTemp_degC := (rBedTemp_A_degC + rBedTemp_B_degC) * 0.5;
    iBedHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bBedSensorFail_C := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: TT_01C Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSIF (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_BC) AND (bBedDiscrepancy_AB AND bBedDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_BedTemp_degC := (rBedTemp_B_degC + rBedTemp_C_degC) * 0.5;
    iBedHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bBedSensorFail_A := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: TT_01A Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSIF (NOT bBedDiscrepancy_CA) AND (bBedDiscrepancy_AB AND bBedDiscrepancy_BC) THEN
    rVoted_BedTemp_degC := (rBedTemp_C_degC + rBedTemp_A_degC) * 0.5;
    iBedHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bBedSensorFail_B := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: TT_01B Discrepancy Failure *)
ELSE
    iBedHealthySensorCount := 0;
    wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: 2oo3 Temperature Instrumentation Trip *)
    rVoted_BedTemp_degC := 140.0;           (* Safe high assumption to trip heaters *)
    bAlarmTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- Sub-System C: Effluent Slip CO2 GC / NDIR 2oo3 (AT_01A, AT_01B, AT_01C) [ppm] --- *)
bSlipDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rSlipCO2_A_ppm - rSlipCO2_B_ppm) > rSlipDiscrepancyTol_ppm;
bSlipDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rSlipCO2_B_ppm - rSlipCO2_C_ppm) > rSlipDiscrepancyTol_ppm;
bSlipDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rSlipCO2_C_ppm - rSlipCO2_A_ppm) > rSlipDiscrepancyTol_ppm;

IF (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_AB) AND (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_BC) AND (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := (rSlipCO2_A_ppm + rSlipCO2_B_ppm + rSlipCO2_C_ppm) / 3.0;
    iSlipHealthySensorCount := 3;
    bSlipSensorFail_A := FALSE;
    bSlipSensorFail_B := FALSE;
    bSlipSensorFail_C := FALSE;
ELSIF (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_AB) AND (bSlipDiscrepancy_BC AND bSlipDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := (rSlipCO2_A_ppm + rSlipCO2_B_ppm) * 0.5;
    iSlipHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bSlipSensorFail_C := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: AT_01C Analyzer Divergence *)
ELSIF (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_BC) AND (bSlipDiscrepancy_AB AND bSlipDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := (rSlipCO2_B_ppm + rSlipCO2_C_ppm) * 0.5;
    iSlipHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bSlipSensorFail_A := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: AT_01A Analyzer Divergence *)
ELSIF (NOT bSlipDiscrepancy_CA) AND (bSlipDiscrepancy_AB AND bSlipDiscrepancy_BC) THEN
    rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := (rSlipCO2_C_ppm + rSlipCO2_A_ppm) * 0.5;
    iSlipHealthySensorCount := 2;
    bSlipSensorFail_B := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0100; (* Bit 8: AT_01B Analyzer Divergence *)
ELSE
    iSlipHealthySensorCount := 0;
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0200; (* Bit 9: 2oo3 Slip Analyzer Complete Degradation *)
    (* Graceful median fallback *)
    IF (rSlipCO2_A_ppm >= rSlipCO2_B_ppm AND rSlipCO2_A_ppm <= rSlipCO2_C_ppm) OR
       (rSlipCO2_A_ppm >= rSlipCO2_C_ppm AND rSlipCO2_A_ppm <= rSlipCO2_B_ppm) THEN
        rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := rSlipCO2_A_ppm;
    ELSIF (rSlipCO2_B_ppm >= rSlipCO2_A_ppm AND rSlipCO2_B_ppm <= rSlipCO2_C_ppm) OR
          (rSlipCO2_B_ppm >= rSlipCO2_C_ppm AND rSlipCO2_B_ppm <= rSlipCO2_A_ppm) THEN
        rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := rSlipCO2_B_ppm;
    ELSE
        rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm := rSlipCO2_C_ppm;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Map voted slip signal to primary telemetry output *)
rSlipRate_ppm := rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm;

(* Evaluate Graceful Degradation flag *)
bDegradedMode := (iVacHealthySensorCount < 3) OR (iBedHealthySensorCount < 3) OR (iSlipHealthySensorCount < 3);

(* Sorbent Chemical Safety: Thermal Degradation Critical Trip *)
IF rVoted_BedTemp_degC >= rAMINE_MAX_TEMP_LIMIT THEN
    wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Sorbent Amine Thermal Breakdown Trip *)
    bAlarmTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Environmental Slip Breakthrough Critical Trip *)
IF rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm >= rSLIP_BREAKTHRU_TRIP_PPM THEN
    wAlarmWord1 := wAlarmWord1 OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Contactor CO2 Breakthrough Trip *)
    bAlarmTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3. SOLID-SORBENT ISOTHERM KINETICS & AMINE THERMAL AGING ACCUMULATOR                             *)
(* Non-linear dual-site Langmuir-Freundlich equilibrium loading and Arrhenius degradation rate       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Atmospheric CO2 Partial Pressure [bar] *)
rPartialPressCO2_bar := (rBarometricPress_mbar * 100.0) * (420.0 * 1.0E-6) / 100000.0;

(* Moisture Enhancement Factor: Bicarbonate reaction pathway under ambient humidity *)
rMoistureEnhanceFactor := 1.0 + (0.0035 * rAirRelHumidity_pct);
IF rMoistureEnhanceFactor > 1.35 THEN
    rMoistureEnhanceFactor := 1.35;
END_IF;

(* Dual-Site Langmuir-Freundlich Equilibrium Loading Calculation *)
rLangmuirTerm1 := rSite1_Capacity_molkg * (rAffinityConst1 * rPartialPressCO2_bar) / (1.0 + (rAffinityConst1 * rPartialPressCO2_bar));
rLangmuirTerm2 := rSite2_Capacity_molkg * (rAffinityConst2 * rPartialPressCO2_bar) / (1.0 + (rAffinityConst2 * rPartialPressCO2_bar));
rIsothermLoading_molkg := (rLangmuirTerm1 + rLangmuirTerm2) * rMoistureEnhanceFactor;

(* Arrhenius Thermal Degradation Rate of Supported Solid Amine: k_deg = A * exp(-Ea / (R * T)) *)
IF rVoted_BedTemp_degC > 85.0 THEN
    rDegradationRate_per_hr := rARRHENIUS_FREQ_FACTOR * EXP(- (rARRHENIUS_ACTIVATION_EA * 1000.0) / (rR_GAS_CONST * 1000.0 * (rVoted_BedTemp_degC + 273.15)));
    rCumulativeHoursAtTemp := rCumulativeHoursAtTemp + (rTS_CYCLE_SEC / 3600.0);
    rSorbentCapacityLoss_pct := rSorbentCapacityLoss_pct + (rDegradationRate_per_hr * (rTS_CYCLE_SEC / 3600.0) * 100.0);
    IF rSorbentCapacityLoss_pct > 25.0 THEN
        wAlarmWord3 := wAlarmWord3 OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Sorbent Lifetime Exceeded Warning *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4. FIRST-PRINCIPLES MASS & ENERGY BALANCE AND RECOVERY KPIS                                       *)
(* Real-time estimation of capture mass, specific energy, and condensation heat recovery             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Air Density from Ideal Gas Law based on real barometric pressure and ambient temperature *)
rInletAirDensity_kgm3 := ((rBarometricPress_mbar * 100.0) * (rMOL_WEIGHT_AIR / 1000.0)) / (rR_GAS_CONST * 1000.0 * (rAirTemp_degC + 273.15));
rInletAirMassFlow_kgh := rAirFlowRate_m3h * rInletAirDensity_kgm3;

(* Inlet Carbon Dioxide Mass Flux *)
rInletCO2MassFlow_kgh := rInletAirMassFlow_kgh * (420.0 * 1.0E-6) * (rMOL_WEIGHT_CO2 / rMOL_WEIGHT_AIR);

(* Effluent Carbon Dioxide Slip Mass Flux *)
rEffluentCO2MassFlow_kgh := rInletAirMassFlow_kgh * (rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm * 1.0E-6) * (rMOL_WEIGHT_CO2 / rMOL_WEIGHT_AIR);

(* Net Real-Time CO2 Adsorption / Desorption Production Yield *)
rNetCaptureRate_kgh := rInletCO2MassFlow_kgh - rEffluentCO2MassFlow_kgh;
IF rNetCaptureRate_kgh < 0.0 THEN
    rNetCaptureRate_kgh := 0.0;
END_IF;
rCO2Production_kgh := rNetCaptureRate_kgh;

(* Instantaneous Contactor Capture Efficiency *)
IF rInletCO2MassFlow_kgh > 0.01 THEN
    rCaptureEfficiency_pct := (rNetCaptureRate_kgh / rInletCO2MassFlow_kgh) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCaptureEfficiency_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Thermal & Electrical Energy Integration *)
rSteamSpecificThermal_kW := (rSteamFlow_kgh / 3600.0) * (rSteamEnthalpy_kJkg - (4.184 * rCondensateTemp_degC));
rTotalPower_kW := rSteamSpecificThermal_kW + (rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct * 0.52); (* Plus vacuum electrical work *)

IF rCO2Production_kgh > 0.05 THEN
    rSpecificEnergy_kJkgCO2 := (rTotalPower_kW * 3600.0) / rCO2Production_kgh;
ELSE
    rSpecificEnergy_kJkgCO2 := 9999.0;
END_IF;

(* Cumulative Integration *)
rTotalCO2Captured_kg := rTotalCO2Captured_kg + (rCO2Production_kgh * (rTS_CYCLE_SEC / 3600.0));
rTotalSteamConsumed_kg := rTotalSteamConsumed_kg + (rSteamFlow_kgh * (rTS_CYCLE_SEC / 3600.0));
rTotalThermalEnergy_kJ := rTotalThermalEnergy_kJ + (rSteamSpecificThermal_kW * rTS_CYCLE_SEC);
rTotalElectricEnergy_kJ := rTotalElectricEnergy_kJ + ((rVacuumPumpSpeed_pct * 0.52) * rTS_CYCLE_SEC);

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5. WASTE HEAT RECUPERATION THERMOCLINE NUMERICAL MODEL (8-NODE AXIAL PDE)                         *)
(* Finite-difference conduction-advection discretization tracking sensible thermocline front         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Thermal Front Migration Velocity v_th [m/s] *)
rThermoclineFrontVel := (rSorbentFeedRate_kgh / 3600.0) / (650.0 * rBedCrossSection_m2 * 0.58);

(* Boundary Condition: Top Node 1 in contact with hot regenerated sorbent discharge *)
rThermoclineNodes[1] := rThermoclineNodes[1] + ((rThermoclineInletTemp_degC - rThermoclineNodes[1]) * 0.12);

(* Interior Finite Difference PDE Discretization for Nodes 2 to 7 *)
FOR i := 2 TO 7 DO
    (* Axial thermal conduction component *)
    rNodeConduction := (rThermalDiffusivity_m2s / (rBedNodeHeight_m * rBedNodeHeight_m)) * 
                       (rThermoclineNodes[i - 1] - (2.0 * rThermoclineNodes[i]) + rThermoclineNodes[i + 1]);
    (* Axial convective advection component *)
    rNodeAdvection := - (rThermoclineFrontVel / rBedNodeHeight_m) * (rThermoclineNodes[i] - rThermoclineNodes[i - 1]);
    
    rThermoclineNodes[i] := rThermoclineNodes[i] + ((rNodeConduction + rNodeAdvection) * rTS_CYCLE_SEC * 12.0);
END_FOR;

(* Boundary Condition: Bottom Node 8 in contact with cold saturated incoming sorbent *)
rThermoclineNodes[8] := rThermoclineNodes[8] + ((rAirTemp_degC - rThermoclineNodes[8]) * 0.08);

(* Instantaneous Recuperated Sensible Heat Power [kW] *)
rRecupDuty_kW := (rSorbentFeedRate_kgh / 3600.0) * rCP_SORBENT * (rThermoclineNodes[1] - rThermoclineNodes[8]);
IF rRecupDuty_kW < 0.0 THEN
    rRecupDuty_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Exergy Efficiency of Thermal Stratification *)
IF (rThermoclineNodes[1] + 273.15) > 0.0 AND (rAirTemp_degC + 273.15) > 0.0 THEN
    rExergyEfficiency_pct := (1.0 - ((rAirTemp_degC + 273.15) / (rThermoclineNodes[1] + 273.15))) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rExergyEfficiency_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Peclet Number Diagnostic: checks advection dominance vs destratification conduction *)
IF rThermalDiffusivity_m2s > 1.0E-8 THEN
    rPecletNumber := (rThermoclineFrontVel * rBedNodeHeight_m) / rThermalDiffusivity_m2s;
END_IF;

(* Inversion Hazard Detection: Cold upper layer / hot lower layer destratification *)
IF (rThermoclineNodes[1] < rThermoclineNodes[4]) OR (rThermoclineNodes[2] < rThermoclineNodes[6]) THEN
    wAlarmWord2 := wAlarmWord2 OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: Thermocline Thermal Stratification Inversion *)
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6. DISCRETE 4x4 STATE-SPACE CYBER-PHYSICAL OBSERVER (LUENBERGER ESTIMATION)                       *)
(* x(k+1) = Ad * x(k) + Bd * u(k) + Ld * (y_meas(k) - Cd * x(k))                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Map Physical Sensor Variables to Normalized Deviation Coordinates *)
rY_meas[1] := rVoted_BedTemp_degC - 100.0;         (* Deviation around 100 deg C operating point *)
rY_meas[2] := rVoted_VacPress_mbar - 220.0;        (* Deviation around 220 mbar deep vacuum *)
rY_meas[3] := rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm - 15.0;           (* Deviation around 15 ppm slip baseline *)
rY_meas[4] := rThermoclineNodes[3] - 80.0;         (* Deviation around 80 deg C thermocline core *)

(* Compute A Priori State Prediction: x_pred = Ad * x_hat + Bd * u_prev *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (Ad[i, j] * rX_hat[j]) + (Bd[i, j] * (rU_prev[j] * 0.01));
    END_FOR;
    rX_pred[i] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Compute Output Prediction: y_pred = Cd * x_pred *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (Cd[i, j] * rX_pred[j]);
    END_FOR;
    rY_pred[i] := rTempSum;
    rY_resid[i] := rY_meas[i] - rY_pred[i];         (* Innovation residual vector *)
END_FOR;

(* Correct State Estimate via Observer Gain: x_hat = x_pred + Ld * y_resid *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (Ld[i, j] * rY_resid[j]);
    END_FOR;
    rX_hat[i] := rX_pred[i] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7. MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) FINITE HORIZON QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION ENGINE                    *)
(* Projected Gradient Descent with Diagonal Preconditioning & Actuator Slew Rate Constraints         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Update Multi-Step State Horizon Rollout (Np = 3) *)
FOR h := 1 TO 3 DO
    FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
            IF h = 1 THEN
                rTempSum := rTempSum + (Ad[i, j] * rX_hat[j]) + (Bd[i, j] * (rU_opt[j] * 0.01));
            ELSE
                rTempSum := rTempSum + (Ad[i, j] * rX_horizon[h - 1, j]) + (Bd[i, j] * (rU_opt[j] * 0.01));
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        rX_horizon[h, i] := rTempSum;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Calculate Diagonal Preconditioned Hessian Approximations *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rHessianDiag[i] := (rQ_diag[i] * 0.185) + rR_diag[i];
    IF rHessianDiag[i] < 0.02 THEN
        rHessianDiag[i] := 0.02;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Loops (3-Step Real-Time Iterations) *)
FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO 3 DO
    (* Compute Analytical Gradients Grad_J = Q * (x_horizon[3] - rSetpoints) * B_col + R * (u - u_prev) *)
    rGradJ[1] := (rQ_diag[1] * (rX_horizon[3, 1] - rSetpoints[1]) * 0.1850) + (rR_diag[1] * (rU_opt[1] - rU_prev[1]));
    rGradJ[2] := (rQ_diag[2] * (rX_horizon[3, 2] - rSetpoints[2]) * (-0.2450)) + (rR_diag[2] * (rU_opt[2] - rU_prev[2]));
    rGradJ[3] := (rQ_diag[3] * (rX_horizon[3, 3] - rSetpoints[3]) * (-0.1950)) + (rR_diag[3] * (rU_opt[3] - rU_prev[3]));
    rGradJ[4] := (rQ_diag[4] * (rX_horizon[3, 4] - rSetpoints[4]) * 0.1680) + (rR_diag[4] * (rU_opt[4] - rU_prev[4]));
    
    (* Preconditioned Update & Box Constraint Projection *)
    FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
        rU_opt[i] := rU_opt[i] - (rStepAlpha * (rGradJ[i] / rHessianDiag[i]));
        
        (* Projection onto Physical Actuator Saturation Limits [u_min, u_max] *)
        IF rU_opt[i] < rU_min[i] THEN
            rU_opt[i] := rU_min[i];
        ELSIF rU_opt[i] > rU_max[i] THEN
            rU_opt[i] := rU_max[i];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Enforcement of Actuator Slew Rate Clamping *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rActuatorDelta := rU_opt[i] - rU_prev[i];
    IF rActuatorDelta > rDeltaU_max[i] THEN
        rU_opt[i] := rU_prev[i] + rDeltaU_max[i];
    ELSIF rActuatorDelta < -rDeltaU_max[i] THEN
        rU_opt[i] := rU_prev[i] - rDeltaU_max[i];
    END_IF;
    rU_prev[i] := rU_opt[i];
END_FOR;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 8. GAS CHROMATOGRAPHY CO2 SLIP SMITH PREDICTOR & RING BUFFER DEAD-TIME COMPENSATION               *)
(* Preempts breakthrough by driving sorbent bed advance ahead of delayed chromatographic analysis    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Push into 30-step Ring Buffer (15 seconds total dead-time coverage at 0.5s Ts) *)
rSlipFifoBuffer[iFifoIndex] := rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm;
iFifoIndex := iFifoIndex + 1;
IF iFifoIndex > 29 THEN
    iFifoIndex := 0;
END_IF;

(* Low-Pass Filter on Slip Measurement *)
rSlipFiltered_ppm := rSlipFiltered_ppm + ((rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm - rSlipFiltered_ppm) * 0.12);

(* Compute Instantaneous Slip Rate of Change [ppm/s] across delayed horizon *)
rSlipRateOfChange_ppms := (rVoted_SlipCO2_ppm - rSlipFifoBuffer[iFifoIndex]) / (30.0 * rTS_CYCLE_SEC);

(* Dynamic Bed Velocity Trim Calculation *)
IF rSlipFiltered_ppm > rSLIP_TARGET_MAX_PPM THEN
    rSlipPredictorCorrection := ((rSlipFiltered_ppm - rSLIP_TARGET_MAX_PPM) * 0.95) + (rSlipRateOfChange_ppms * 3.4);
    IF rSlipPredictorCorrection > 15.0 THEN
        rSlipPredictorCorrection := 15.0;     (* Cap maximum feedforward velocity bump *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rSlipPredictorCorrection := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 9. SEQUENTIAL MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF ... END_CASE;)                     *)
(* Full TVSA Cycle: Idle -> Adsorb -> Evacuate -> Desorb -> Extract -> Recuperate -> Cool -> Transfer*)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Update Master Sequence Dwell Timer *)
